Never bundled by webpack, never part of the shipped task pane, and the only ZIPs it opens are the manifest bundles we produce ourselves. npm's only 'fix' is a downgrade to office-addin-debugging 4.6.7, outside the declared ^5.0.12 range. REMOVE WHEN: the office-addin-* chain ships adm-zip >=0.6.0 inside that range (the weekly dev-dep Dependabot bump will carry it).

@azure/msal-node 6.0.1 authorization-code parameter disclosure, present in word-addin only through the devDependency office-addin-debugging -> office-addin-dev-settings -> @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli -> @azure/identity (`npm ls @azure/msal-node --omit=dev` is empty). That CLI signs a developer into Microsoft 365 for sideloading; the add-in has no MSAL code of its own and the production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs. The patched msal-node 7.1.0 needs a semver-major office-addin-debugging. REMOVE WHEN: office-addin-debugging's declared range resolves @azure/msal-node >=7.1.0.
